title: Intersegmental rotation under 3.75 Nm pure moments, 4-segment lumbar spine, corpectomy + graft + fixator

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: intersegmental rotation in the loading plane at 3.75 Nm (one side, from unloaded neutral; LB/AR averaged L/R), 3rd cycle, median (min-max)

source.authors: Rohlmann A, Neller S, Bergmann G, Graichen F, Claes L, Wilke HJ
source.sample: human cadaver lumbar spines, fresh-frozen, ligaments/capsules intact; 7 specimens (4 L1-L5, 3 T12-L4 four-segment spines)

protocol.summary: Four-segment specimens (L1-L5 or T12-L4) potted in PMMA cups; lower end fixed, upper end in a gimbal with stepper motors applying pure moments ±3.75 Nm, 1.7 deg/s, three cycles, 3rd cycle evaluated, no preload, 5 uncontrolled DOF. Moments in FE, left/right LB, left/right AR (LB and AR averaged over both sides). IDP: 1.2 mm flexible piezo-resistive sensor (MIPM) in the nucleus of all four discs (X-ray checked); intersegmental rotation in the loading plane by ultrasound motion analysis (Zebris). Conditions in order: (1) intact; (2) intact + bisegmental internal fixator bridging the middle vertebra (Schanz screws 5 mm in the 4 adjacent pedicles); (3) corpectomy of the bridged vertebra (both adjacent discs and body removed, posterior ligament and pedicles kept) with a cylindrical wooden graft + fixator; (4) corpectomy with fixator, no graft. Disc/segment positions pooled over specimens: above = L1-L2 (or T12-L1), bridged = L2-L3 & L3-L4 (or L1-L2 & L2-L3), below = L4-L5 (or L3-L4).
how_to_simulate: Model a 4-segment lumbar spine (L1-L5); fix L5 caudal endplate, apply pure moment ±3.75 Nm at L1 in FE, LB, AR with no preload.
Simulate each condition: intact; bisegmental posterior fixator L2-L4 (bridging L3); L3 corpectomy with a rigid graft + fixator; corpectomy with fixator only.

Report for each disc the change of nucleus pressure from the unloaded state to the 3.75 Nm peak, and each segment's rotation in the loading plane (one side; LB/AR averaged L/R); compare with median and range.
protocol.notes: Changes of IDP are relative to the unloaded neutral pressure (absolute neutral ~0.09 MPa, see fe_idp_invitro.rohlmann2001a test). In bridged segments with graft/corpectomy the two bridged discs no longer exist (IDP only for intact and fixator). Bridged-segment graft and corpectomy rotations are plotted identically for both bridged segments in Figs 2-5 (as digitised).

extraction.from: Figs 2-5 (median bars, max triangles, min squares)
extraction.uncertainty: bars ±0.03 deg; marker centres ±0.08 deg (Fig 2), ±0.12 (Fig 3), ±0.15 (Fig 4), ±0.05 (Fig 5) - half marker height
extraction.check_notes: Figures are 400 dpi CCITT images (pdfimages). Axes calibrated from tick marks; bars from top-edge rows (horizontal opening), markers by 9x9 morphological opening (triangle centre corrected +4 px for clipped apex, checked on raw pixels), missing edges re-read by row-fill scan. Every value re-checked visually against a downscaled render of each figure. Text checks: AR rotation ~1 deg per lumbar level (intact medians 0.55-1.25 deg); disc above fixator ext difference highly significant (median 0.029 -> 0.036/0.103/0.120).

shared_sample_with: rohlmann2001a: same 7 specimens in all four conditions (intact, fixator, graft, corpectomy)
